Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzes the differential interactome of the Fas C-terminal PDZ-binding motif by comparing a wild-type peptide bait against a mutant (ΔSLV) peptide bait. While the broader study involves siRNA and FasL treatments, the MS data (PXD009659) is derived from this specific peptide pulldown assay.
